title: poa chaixii var. rubens
intro: Poa chaixii var. rubens, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This perennial grass is known for its ability to thrive in poor soil conditions and is often used for landscaping and erosion control. The health benefits of Red Fescue include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function due to its rich content of flavonoids and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Red Fescue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
